mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and increasing equity valuation sensitivity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals a tightening cycle, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuation sensitivity, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) exceeding 2,000 over three months indicates a labor market softening, reducing equity risk premia and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising benefits periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 1,500 for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, increasing equity risk premia and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling benefits periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 120 for three consecutive months indicates a supply-side expansion, reducing equity risk premia and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising production periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 for three consecutive months signals a supply-side contraction, increasing equity risk premia and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling production periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 0.2% for three consecutive months indicates a disinflationary trend, reducing equity risk premia and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.3% for three consecutive months signals a re-accelerating inflationary trend, increasing equity risk premia and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in accelerating inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
